title: Materialize netstandard1.x compile inputs from the autoReferenced NETStandard.Library closure
outcome: Exact netstandard1.x F# ProjectReference children use their restored granular NETStandard.Library and FSharp.Core compile assets without widening authority.
acceptance: AutoReferenced NETStandard.Library and matching restored FSharp.Core compile assets are traversed from project.assets.json under the existing dependency-node and 256 MiB binary budgets.
Every selected binary is captured from the pinned snapshot and reverified before semantic results are emitted.
No netstandard2.0 reference-pack substitution is used for a netstandard1.x child, and end-to-end compatibility tests resolve against genuine 1.x inputs.
